title: anthoxanthum rariflorum
intro: Anthoxanthum rariflorum, commonly known as false oat grass or variegated oat grass, is a species of flowering plant in the grass family. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Anthoxanthum rariflorum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
